title: Verify affected fork behavior after upstream integration
abstract: After integrating authorized upstream changes into a Rust fork, run appropriate tests and focused compatibility or regression checks against the fork's promised interfaces, supported platforms and preserved customizations, and record any unresolved failures before describing the integration as complete.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only separately authorized work on an existing Rust fork and its explicitly identified upstream; neither queueing nor this proposed requirement authorizes repository edits, upstream integrations, releases, or unrelated work.

unresolved: Constrain the verification matrix to affected behavior while retaining the fork's documented compatibility promises.
remarks: Provisional Rust-fork maintenance rule proposal derived from a documented gap in the public Nomos draft-profile review. Queued only: no rule ID assigned, no processing record, no draft-profile edits, no automatic activation.
